View 3175 Courtenay St V6R 3Y2 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 3 bed, 3 bath, 2450 Sq. Ft. house. 3175 Courtenay St is currently on market.
Available: Now! We are offering a spacious 3 bedroom / 3 bathroom detached home featuring approximately 2,450 sqft of interior living space. With generous indoor and outdoor spaces, this home offers a comfortable and functional layout ideal for families or anyone looking for additional room to live, work, and entertain. The home features a combination of hardwood flooring and carpet, in-unit laundry, and a cozy two-sided gas fireplace. The kitchen is equipped with a fridge, stove, and dishwasher, providing everything needed for convenient everyday living. Enjoy excellent outdoor space with both a private patio and balcony. The property also includes a detached two-car garage, providing convenient parking and additional functionality.    Located in the west side of Vancouver near Pacific Spirit Park, this home offers convenient access to parks, schools, shopping, restaurants, grocery stores, public transit, and everyday amenities. The residential setting provides comfortable family living while maintaining convenient connections throughout Vancouver. -   Approximate Square Footage: 2,450 sqft -   Number of Bedrooms: 3 -   Number of Bathrooms: 3 -   Type of Unit: Single Family Detached Home -   Laundry: In-unit -   Flooring: Hardwood and Carpet -   Fireplace: Gas Fireplace -   Outdoor Space: Patio and Balcony -   Garage: Detached Garage -   Pet Policy: 1 pet permitted (35lb max fully grown) -   Smoking: No smoking, growing, or processing of any cigarettes, marijuana, or other combustibles on the property. -   Services Included with Rent: Garbage Removal, Sewer Services, Water. -   Tenant Responsible for: Electricity, Internet, Cable, Gas, Landscaping, and Snow Removal. Deposit(s): 1/2 month's rent as per legislation Minimum Lease Term: 1 year, then month-to-month Tenant's Insurance: Required at possession
